# Synthetic Scanned Tender — Weak / Requires OCR

> *output* of a failed/poor OCR pass on a scanned tender. It contains no
> real data. The garbled text below is intentional — it simulates what a
> scanned PDF with no text layer produces when fed through a weak OCR
> pipeline. The acceptance harness uses this to verify the extraction-quality
> gate correctly flags weak/corrupted extraction and NEVER shows "All Clear".
